<p class="wx-section-label">Software</p>

## BioGeoSyn

An R package that wraps [BioGeoBEARS](http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears) in a
step-by-step graphical interface, so that ancestral-range reconstruction and model
comparison become reproducible — and comparable across clades.

<div class="wx-grid">
  <div class="wx-card">
  <h3>Reproducible GUI</h3>
  <p>A five-step wizard from data upload to results, with standardised output tables and publication-ready figures.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="wx-card">
  <h3>Cross-clade synthesis</h3>
  <p>Pools biogeographic event statistics across multiple groups: range expansion, speciation modes, vicariance and extinction.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="wx-card">
  <h3>Guarded state space</h3>
  <p>Automated state-space monitoring and performance optimisation, so analyses fail fast instead of running for days.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="wx-card">
  <h3>Advanced constraints</h3>
  <p>Time stratification, dispersal multipliers and area-adjacency matrices, all configurable from the interface.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="wx-card">
  <h3>Reports</h3>
  <p>HTML and PDF report generation directly from a completed run.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="wx-card">
  <h3>Portable bundles</h3>
  <p>Result bundles that can be shared with collaborators or attached to a manuscript.</p>
  </div>
</div>

### Install

```r
remotes::install_github("XuWeiEvo/BioGeoSyn")
```

BioGeoBEARS must be installed separately; the app ships with an environment checker
that helps with setup.

### Run

```r
library(BioGeoSyn)
launch_app()          # interactive GUI
# or, scripted:
run_workflow()
```

<p class="wx-section-label">Datasets</p>

## AnnonFruitTraits 1.0

A comprehensive dataset of frugivory-related traits for Annonaceae species
worldwide — fruit and seed morphology assembled to test how dispersal traits shape
tropical rainforest diversity.

Cabral, A., Couvreur, T. L. P., Sauquet, H., Petrocelli, I., Rodrigues-Vaz, C.,
Lozinguez, A., **Xu, W.**, Orellana-Vera, G. & Onstein, R. E. (2026).
[doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-10084032/v1](https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-10084032/v1)
